mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM approval_submission_round r JOIN approval_application a ON a.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND a.id=r.application_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{parameters[0]} AND a.process_key=#{parameters[1]} AND r.definition_version=#{parameters[2]} AND r.status='APPROVED'
SELECT id,process_key,name,version,status FROM approval_definition WHERE tenant_id=#{argument1} ORDER BY updated_at DESC,id LIMIT 1
SELECT id,process_key,name,version,status FROM approval_definition WHERE tenant_id=#{argument1} AND id=#{argument2}

SELECT r.application_id,a.business_no,r.title,r.round_no,r.status,r.submitted_at,r.completed_at FROM approval_submission_round r JOIN approval_application a ON a.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND a.id=r.application_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{argument1} AND a.process_key=#{argument2} AND r.definition_version=#{argument3} AND r.status='APPROVED' ORDER BY r.completed_at DESC, ORDER BY r.submitted_at DESC,r.application_id,r.round_no DESC LIMIT 1
